# Pawan Kalyan (Cintu07)

> Pawan Kalyan, Cintu07 on GitHub, is a self-taught software engineer working on ML infrastructure, inference and databases, previously a founding engineer at Cortex (voice agents for restaurants and clinics). Pull requests merged into tinygrad, apache/arrow-rs, helix-db and others. Writes long posts at https://cintu07.github.io.

## Projects

- [seams](https://cintu07.github.io/seams/): a diff viewer for files too big for everything else. The line diff engine is written by hand in x86-64 assembly and WebAssembly and drawn with WebGL; a million-line diff opens in 0.19 s. CLI, browser library and a GitHub pull request extension. Source: https://github.com/Cintu07/seams
- [ciot](https://github.com/Cintu07/ciot): CPU inference for ternary neural nets in plain C++ and SIMD, with no dependencies.
- [hiraishin](https://github.com/Cintu07/hiraishin): lossless speculative decoding for an 8B model on an 8 GB laptop GPU.
- [heresy](https://github.com/Cintu07/heresy): finds Go code that disagrees with the rest of its codebase.
- [kerneltrace](https://github.com/Cintu07/kerneltrace): experiments that try to break interpretability claims.
- [styx](https://github.com/Cintu07/styx): a membership system that answers with a probability instead of yes or no.
